fact: The promulgation on 20 July 2020 of the law governing statistical activity ended a long process, and the National Statistics Council met on 15 April 2021 to examine three draft implementing texts.
title: An extraordinary session of the National Statistics Council to examine the draft implementing texts of the 2020 statistical law is being held on April 15, 2021
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique du Cameroun
